title: Extract direct tilemap rows
changes: Extend the tilemap row resource with seven noncontiguous rows linked to the extracted direct descriptors, preserving guest indexing and intervening source routing.
validation: Source e200-row-source-u4ror4sy authenticates 84 bytes and all seven existing descriptor dependencies. Wine e200-rows-wine-29if0sg2 preserves 122 other resources, rejects missing dependencies and coherent edits, checks altered mirrored/mixed reads and compares fourteen original interpreter/native reader cases with equal complete state and guest clock.
Wine e200-rows-cli-wine-irh5mvpj creates, reuses and verifies 124 matching files.
limitations: The reader log contains a D-Bus pending-call assertion before successful completion; the Wine host defect is tracked separately. Ordinary use, intervening rows, other consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements were performed.
